about.en: AVGOon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Broadcom, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by AVGO shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding AVGO with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x0d54D4279B9E8c54cD8547c2C75A8Ee81A0BcaE8), BNB Chain and Solana.
